title: 2.5-Hour Small-Group Catamaran Sail with Drinks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the ultimate San Diego sailing adventure with a spacious catamaran cruise, offering your choice of a relaxing daytime sail or a breathtaking sunset sail. Designed for comfort and stability, these modern catamarans feature bow nets for sunbathing, cushioned seating with backrests, and a smooth ocean ride that minimizes rolling, perfect for guests of all ages. With small-group departures that avoid the crowds, this unforgettable San Diego harbor cruise lets you unwind, spot marine life, and enjoy the water without ever feeling like a typical tourist.
